item.text: {"summary":"Handle rvalue ref qualifiers in function types","explanation":"The failing mangled names encode an rvalue reference qualifier (`O`) after the function parameter list. The demangler accepts the lvalue qualifier but does not consume the rvalue qualifier, so parsing fails before it can skip the function type and return `f()`.","edits":[{"path":"absl/debugging/internal/demangle.cc","old":"if (рас)","new":"if (рас)"}]}
